verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents first-party AuthKit CLI Auth built on the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow (RFC 8628). A device authorization endpoint issues a device code and user code, and the CLI polls for session tokens, so command-line apps authenticate through the browser instead of handling stored secrets. Its OAuth applications docs also explicitly cover CLI tools as user-actor clients. missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/AI-agent use of the device flow (only CLIs are named), independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI Auth flow.
